{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
response_fraction = treatment_only['responded'].mean()

# Compute number of patients in treatment arm
n_patients = len(treatment_only)

# Print both values
print(f'response_fraction = {response_fraction}')
print(f'n_patients = {n_patients}')"}
